title: Prior Authorization Approval Period and Use of Units
content:
## 1. Approval period and units granted

1.1 A Prior Authorization approval at Prairie Ridge Health Plan runs from its start date through its end date. The end date is the start date plus the class's approval period in days, less one day, so that the start date is counted as day 1.

1.2 An approval grants at most the class's most units per approval, counted in the class's unit basis. The units granted are the units requested or the class's most units per approval, whichever is smaller.

## 2. Use of units

2.1 Units are used only by paid claims with a service date from the start date through the end date and from the servicing provider on the authorization.

2.2 Where the class sets a weekly frequency cap, no more than that cap is used in one Monday-to-Sunday week. The units counted against the cap are the units posted as used on the authorization with service dates in the Monday-to-Sunday week that contains the claim's service date.

2.3 Units are used only on an authorization in approved or expired status whose dates contain the claim's service date. The status and dates are read from the plan's authorization record for that authorization.

## 3. Units left at the end date

3.1 Retired clause: "Units left on the end date are released the next day and cannot be used later where the class forfeits expired units." This clause is **no longer in force**. Units unused on an approval whose end date has passed are now governed by the plan's current basis for the expiry release of an ended approval.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

**End date.** A hypothetical approval starts on March 1 in a class with a 60-day approval period. March 1 is day 1, March 31 is day 31, and April 29 is day 60, so the end date is April 29.

**Units granted.** A hypothetical request asks for 15 units in a class whose most units per approval is 12: 12 units are granted. A request for 8 units in the same class: 8 units are granted.

**Weekly cap.** In a hypothetical class with a weekly cap of 3, where 3 units are already posted as used for service dates from Monday through Wednesday of one week, a paid claim for Friday of that same week does not use a unit of the authorization; a paid claim for the following Monday falls in a new week.

**Status and dates.**

| Authorization status | Claim's service date inside the start date through end date | Units used |
|---|---|---|
| approved | Yes | Yes |
| expired | Yes | Yes |
| approved or expired | No | No |
| submitted, pended for information, denied, voided or withdrawn | any | No |

superseded_clauses: Units left on end_date are released the next day and cannot be used later where expired_units_forfeited is true.
